profile: Dianthus Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing therapies for severe autoimmune diseases. Its clinical candidates include claseprubart, a monoclonal antibody designed to selectively inhibit active C1s in the classical complement pathway, and DNTH212, a fusion protein targeting plasmacytoid dendritic cells and B-cell function. Claseprubart is being studied in generalized myasthenia gravis, chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy, and multifocal motor neuropathy.
